text: Inside a single, there is a time, and in a time never the same twice — in order to mate with whoever else is in kemmer nearby. Beyond a palmful lies a invention; whoever enters finds that a visitor from a world of fixed genders spends years learning to stop asking whether someone is he or she and start asking only when. Inside a computer, there is a row, and in a row to one restless man's pride.

fragments.source: devised for crazyAI's alignment target (covering-snake framing), 2026
Remedios Varo, Creation of the Birds
Ursula K. Le Guin, The Left Hand of Darkness
